tasks.name: repo-score-pipeline
tasks.prompt: 搜索 GitHub 上活跃的 agent 框架仓库（查询条件用 agent framework），取前 30 个。对每个仓库获取它的详细数据（star 数与 fork 数）。然后按 fork/star 比值（ratio = forks / stars）分支：比值 > 0.15 的仓库获取贡献者路径的分数，其余仓库获取提交路径的分数（两条路径返回的分数同一尺度，可直接比较）。把每条分数对应回它所属的仓库，只保留分数 >= 100 的仓库，按分数从高到低取前 3 个，返回它们的完整名称（owner/repo）。

arguments.answer:
仅 2 个仓库满足分数 >= 100 的条件，按分数从高到低排序：

1. adv/org-repo-1 (score: 750)
2. adv/org-repo-17 (score: 170)

（不足 3 个，只列出满足条件的仓库）

arguments.source:
repos = github.search_repositories(query="agent framework", limit=30)
details = map(repos, github.get_repository(full_name=_.full_name))
with_ratio = compute(details, ratio="forks / stars")
gt = select(with_ratio, "ratio > 0.15")
le = select(with_ratio, "ratio <= 0.15")
contrib = map(gt, github.get_contributor_stats(full_name=_.full_name))
commits = map(le, github.list_commits(full_name=_.full_name))
scores = concat(contrib, commits)
enriched = merge_by_key(scores, with_ratio, key="full_name")
kept = select(enriched, "score >= 100")
ranked = sort(kept, key="score", desc=true)
top = take(ranked, 3)
return top

details = map(repos, github.get_repository(full_name=_.full_name))
ratio = compute(details, ratio="forks / stars")
high = select(ratio, "ratio > 0.15")
low = select(ratio, "ratio <= 0.15")
highscores = map(high, github.get_contributor_stats(full_name=_.full_name))
lowscores = map(low, github.list_commits(full_name=_.full_name))
both = concat(highscores, lowscores)
filtered = select(both, "score >= 100")
ranked = sort(filtered, key="score", desc=true)
top = take(ranked, 3)
return top
